items.briefing:
A new survey highlights two notable risks for Australian and New Zealand organisations today. More than half of ANZ businesses have experienced a print-related security incident, a reminder that physical devices like printers are often overlooked weak points. Separately, while SMEs across ANZ are rapidly adopting AI tools, many staff don't fully trust or understand them — a gap that can lead to poor decisions or misuse.

Global outages linked to Cloudflare's infrastructure also affected services this week, underlining how dependent organisations are on third-party platforms. **Practical tip:** Check that your office printers require user authentication before releasing print jobs — this simple step can prevent sensitive documents falling into the wrong hands.

featured.title: Print security incidents hit over half in ANZ survey
featured.quote: Print security breaches affect over half of ANZ organisations, revealing critical infrastructure vulnerability.
